test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states does NOT share its border with Myanmar?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Assam__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assam** does** not share** its **border with Myanmar.**
 
• **Myanmar shares **the border with four Northeast Indian states **Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Mizoram**, and **Manipur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Seven Sister States**: a region in northeastern India comprising the contiguous states of **Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, and Tripura**.
 
• India shares borders with **10 countries**:
 
 
• In the north or north-west: **China, Bhutan, Nepal, Pakistan, Afghanistan**.
 
• In the east: **Bangladesh, Myanmar**.
 
• Water borders: **Sri Lanka, Maldives, Indonesia**.
